Bugün telefonuna ilk bakışın uyandıktan: How many minutes after waking up did you first look at your phone today? Show with your hand: 0–5 min, 5–30 min, more than 30 min. Nobody is judged, we just notice.
Bilerek: bir amacım var, işim bitince bı: On purpose: I have a goal and I stop when I'm done
Otomatik: elim kendiliğinden telefona gi: Automatic: my hand goes to the phone by itself
Bildirim sesi gelince 'bakmam lazım' his: The urge to 'check' when a notification sounds is automatic
Fark etmek, değiştirmenin ilk adımıdır: Noticing is the first step to changing
Sonsuz kaydırma: sayfa hiç bitmez: Infinite scroll: the page never ends

Yeni ve sürpriz şeyler beynimizde keyif: New and surprising things create a pleasure signal in the brain
Ekran bunu saniyeler içinde, tekrar tekr: Screens deliver this within seconds, again and again
Sürekli hızlı uyarana alışan beyin, yava: A brain used to constant fast stimulation can get bored with slow tasks (books, lessons)
İyi haber: alışkanlıklar yeniden şekille: Good news: habits can be reshaped

Uykusuz beyin dikkat etmekte ve duygular: A sleepy brain struggles to pay attention and manage emotions

Telefon masada duruyorsa, sessizde bile: A phone on the table splits our attention even when silent
Aynı anda iki iş yapmak, ikisini de yava: Doing two things at once slows down both
Yemekte ve sohbette ekran, karşımızdakin: A screen during meals and conversation can send the message 'you aren't important'
Kullanmadığında huzursuzluk, süreyi sakl: Restlessness when you don't use it, hiding how long you use it, cutting back on sleep and responsibilities, losing interest in things you love. If you notice a few of these, talk to a trusted adult.

Şırıngalar ve borularla çalışan hidrolik: A hydraulic robot arm that works with syringes and tubes. When you push one syringe, the fluid moves to the other and the arm moves.
Makara sistemiyle yük kaldıran asansör m: A lift model that raises a load with a pulley system. The booklet goes step by step from the base to the roof.
LEGO'nun kendi MR setinin SPIKE Prime pa: A step-by-step build guide for a rebuild of LEGO's own MRI set using SPIKE Prime parts, plus a preparation guide for explaining the MRI to a child.
Uzun bir taban (en az 16×32 studluk), ci: A long base (at least 16×32 studs), the machine's two side columns and the top beam. The MRI machine should look like a "ring": the tunnel wide enough for a minifigure to fit (at least 6 studs).
Yuvarlak halkayı yatay yarım daireler ve: Build the round ring with horizontal half circles and plates. Leave the inside open. Put a flat panel with the machine's name in front of the ring.
Taban üzerinde, tünelin içinden geçen bi: Build a rail on the base that passes through the tunnel. The patient bed slides on the rail; it can be pushed by a SPIKE Prime motor or by hand.
Büyük motor ve dişli ile yatağı tünele y: Build a mechanism with a large motor and gears that slowly moves the bed into and out of the tunnel. Hide the hub in the control room. One button press moves the bed in, another moves it out.
Teknisyen minifigürü ve ekran (cam veya: Add a small room with a technician minifigure and a screen (glass or sticker). Let the child see from the model that "the technician can see me".
Hub hoparlörüyle yumuşak 'tak tak' sesi;: You can program a soft "tak tak" sound with the hub speaker and a blinking "scan in progress" light with the light matrix. Keep the volume as low as the child is comfortable with.
Minifigür yatakta rahatça yatabiliyor mu: Can the minifigure lie comfortably on the bed?
Yatak tünele takılmadan giriyor ve çıkıy: Does the bed move in and out of the tunnel without catching?
Motor çok hızlı değil mi? (çocuk korkmas: Is the motor too fast? (so the child is not scared)
Tüm kenarlar ve küçük parçalar çocuk içi: Are all edges and small parts safe for the child?
Çocuğa MR'ı nasıl anlatırız?: How do we explain the MRI to a child?
MR, vücudun içini fotoğraflamak için güç: An MRI is a machine that uses a strong magnet and radio waves to take pictures of the inside of the body. It does not hurt and gives no radiation. The child just lies still.
Makine yüksek sesli 'tak tak', 'vızz' se: The machine makes loud "tak tak" and "vzzz" sounds. Headphones or earplugs are provided. The sounds show that the machine is working.
Ne yapman gerekiyor?: What do you need to do?
Hiç kıpırdamadan yatmak. Çekim sırasında: Lie completely still. During the scan our toy figure stays still too; play the "statue game".
Hayır. Teknisyen seni görür ve duyar. Ço: No. The technician can see and hear you. Often an adult can wait beside you.
Bu içerik hastanenin yönergelerinin yeri: This content does not replace the hospital's guidelines. Follow your hospital's instructions on sedation, fasting and metal objects.
Modeli çekimden birkaç gün önce çocukla: Build the model with your child a few days before the scan and play it out, swapping roles (the child is the patient, you are the technician).
Hastane izin veriyorsa önceden MR odasın: If the hospital allows, ask to see the MRI room beforehand.
15 seviyeli, dikkat dağıtmayan, tek komu: A 15-level open-source puzzle game with no distractions, controlled by a single command.
Çocuğa oyunu dayatmayın. Birlikte bir se: Don't force the game on the child. Play one level together, then let the child decide. A quiet room and enough light are enough.
15 seviye; yön komutları, tekrar (döngü): The 15 levels teach direction commands, repetition (loops), jumping and sequential thinking through single-command movement.
Çözümü söylemeyin. 'Önce ne yapmalı? Son: Don't give the solution. Ask 'What should we do first? Then?' Ask the child to say their own steps out loud.
Yorulma belirtisinde mola verin. Her sea: Take a break at signs of tiredness. 10–15 minutes per session is enough. Celebrate small successes.
Minimal arayüz dikkat dağıtıcıları azalt: The minimal interface was designed to reduce distractions. You can reach us on GitHub for feedback and suggestions.

Süre: 20 dakika · FRC 6429 Sense of Scie: Time: 20 minutes · FRC 6429 Sense of Science
Kırmızı, sarı, mavi gıda boyası: Red, yellow and blue food colouring
Bardakları yan yana diz, birer atlayarak: Line up the cups side by side and fill every other one (1st, 3rd, 5th) halfway with water.
1. bardağa kırmızı, 3.'ye sarı, 5.'ye ma: Add red to the 1st cup, yellow to the 3rd and blue to the 5th.
Kâğıt havluyu 6 şeride böl ve ikiye katl: Cut the paper towel into 6 strips and fold them in half.
Her şeridin bir ucunu dolu, diğer ucunu: Dip one end of each strip into a full cup and the other end into an empty cup.
Birkaç dakika bekle ve renklerin boş bar: Wait a few minutes and watch the colours mix in the empty cups.
Kâğıt havlunun lifleri arasındaki ince b: The tiny gaps between the fibres of the paper towel pull water upward. This is called capillary action. Plants carry water from their roots to their leaves in the same way.
Hangi renkler karıştı, ne renk oldu?: Which colours mixed and what colour did they make?
Kalın bir havlu mu ince mi daha hızlı çe: Does a thick towel or a thin one pull faster?
Gıda boyası kıyafeti lekeler, önlük kull: Food colouring stains clothes, so wear an apron. Do the experiment with an adult.
Fill three quarters of the bottle with oil.
Üzerine suyu ekle, yağın yukarıda kaldığ: Add the water on top and see that the oil stays above.
Birkaç damla boya damlat; boya suya iner: Add a few drops of colouring; it sinks into the water.
Break the tablet into pieces and drop them in.
Yağ sudan hafiftir, karışmaz. Tablet sud: Oil is lighter than water and does not mix. The tablet makes gas in water; the gas bubbles carry coloured water up, and when the gas escapes the water sinks again.
Yağ neden suyun üstünde duruyor?: Why does the oil stay on top of the water?
Daha çok tablet atarsan ne olur?: What happens if you add more tablets?
Tableti yutmayın. Şişeyi kapatmayın, gaz: Do not swallow the tablet. Do not close the bottle, gas builds pressure. Do the experiment with an adult.
Süre: 15 dakika · FRC 6429 Sense of Scie: Time: 15 minutes · FRC 6429 Sense of Science
Pour the milk onto the plate.
Drop the colourings randomly onto the milk.
Dip the tip of the cotton swab in dish soap.
Çubuğu sütün ortasına hafifçe dokundur v: Lightly touch the middle of the milk with the swab and watch the colours dance.
Deterjan, sütteki yağ ve proteinleri ite: The soap pushes away the fats and proteins in the milk and lowers the surface tension. The colours rush off in all directions because of this movement.
Yağsız sütle de olur mu?: Does it work with skim milk too?
Deterjan yerine ne dener, ne olur?: What else could you try instead of soap, and what happens?
Sütü içmeyin, deterjana ağzınızı değdirm: Do not drink the milk and do not put your mouth on the soap. Do the experiment with an adult.
Bardağı yarıya kadar suyla doldur ve yum: Fill the glass halfway with water and gently drop in the egg: it sinks to the bottom.
Yumurtayı çıkar. Suya tuzu, kaşıkla karı: Take the egg out. Add the salt to the water, stirring with the spoon.
Yumurtayı tekrar koy: yüzüyor mu?: Put the egg back: does it float?
Üzerine yavaşça saf su ekle ve yumurtanı: Slowly add plain water on top and watch how the egg moves.
Tuz, suyun yoğunluğunu artırır. Su yumur: Salt increases the density of water. When the water is denser than the egg, the egg is pushed up and floats. This is also why people don't sink in the Dead Sea.
Kaç kaşık tuzda yumurta yüzmeye başladı?: How many spoons of salt did it take for the egg to float?
Yumurtayı batırıp yüzdürebildin mi?: Could you make the egg sink and float again?
Çiğ yumurtadan sonra elleri yıka. Deneyi: Wash your hands after touching a raw egg. Do the experiment with an adult.
Balonu şişiren gaz · deney kitapçığı: Gas that inflates a balloon · experiment booklet
Put half a cup of vinegar in the bottle.
Huniyle balonun içine 2 çay kaşığı karbo: Use the funnel to put 2 teaspoons of baking soda into the balloon.
Stretch the neck of the balloon over the mouth of the bottle.
Balonu kaldırıp karbonatı şişeye dök ve: Lift the balloon, pour the baking soda into the bottle and watch.
Sirke (asit) ve karbonat (baz) tepkimeye: Vinegar (an acid) and baking soda (a base) react and release carbon dioxide gas. When the gas has no room in the bottle, it fills the balloon.
Daha çok karbonat daha büyük balon mu ya: Does more baking soda make a bigger balloon?
Balon neden şişti, ses geliyor mu?: Why did the balloon inflate, can you hear anything?
Gözlük tak, şişeyi kapağıyla kapatma. De: Wear goggles and do not seal the bottle with its cap. Do the experiment with an adult.
Süre: 25 dakika · FRC 6429 Sense of Scie: Time: 25 minutes · FRC 6429 Sense of Science
Şişeyi tepsiye yerleştir. İçine yarım ba: Place the bottle on the tray. Put in half a cup of hydrogen peroxide, a little dish soap and colouring.
Ayrı bir kapta 1 yemek kaşığı mayayı 3 y: In a separate container, mix 1 tablespoon of yeast with 3 tablespoons of warm water.
Maya karışımını şişeye dök ve geri çekil: Pour the yeast mixture into the bottle and step back.
Watch the foam overflow from the bottle.
Maya, oksijenli suyu su ve oksijene hızl: Yeast quickly breaks hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen. The oxygen makes foam bubbles with the soap. This is called a catalyst effect.
Köpük sıcak mı? Bu tepkime ısı veriyor m: Is the foam warm? Does this reaction give off heat?
Mayasız denesen ne olur?: What happens if you try it without yeast?
Yalnızca %3'lük oksijenli su kullan, bir: Use only 3% hydrogen peroxide, do it with an adult and wear goggles. Do not touch the foam for long without gloves. Do the experiment with an adult.
Kendi pusulanı yap · deney kitapçığı: Make your own compass · experiment booklet
Mantar ya da küçük köpük parça: Cork or a small piece of foam
İğneyi mıknatısa aynı yönde 30–40 kez sü: Rub the needle against the magnet 30–40 times in the same direction.
İğneyi mantar parçasına yatay şekilde ye: Place the needle horizontally on the piece of cork.
Put the cork on the bowl of water.
İğnenin kendiliğinden dönüp bir yöne dur: Watch the needle turn by itself and settle in one direction, and compare it with a real compass.
Dünya dev bir mıknatıs gibidir. Mıknatıs: The Earth is like a giant magnet. The magnetized needle follows this magnetic field and settles in a north–south direction.
İğne hangi yönü gösteriyor?: Which direction does the needle point?
Yakına başka mıknatıs getirirsen ne olur: What happens if you bring another magnet close?
İğne keskindir. Bir yetişkin yardım etme: The needle is sharp. An adult must help. Do the experiment with an adult.
Süre: 10 dakika · FRC 6429 Sense of Scie: Time: 10 minutes · FRC 6429 Sense of Science
Tabağı suyla doldur ve karabiberi yüzeye: Fill the plate with water and sprinkle black pepper on the surface.
Kuru parmağını suya sok. Biberlere ne ol: Dip your dry finger into the water. What happened to the pepper?
Parmağını deterjana batır, sonra suya so: Dip your finger in dish soap, then into the water.
Biberlerin hızla kenarlara kaçışını izle: Watch the pepper rush to the edges.
Su yüzeyi, hafif bir 'deri' gibi davranı: The water surface behaves like a light 'skin' (surface tension). Soap lowers this tension and the pepper is pulled and pushed to the edges.
